text:
aj: FYI support ticket from ACME — after we pushed regenerated clients yesterday they started seeing increased 401s and a billing spike. cc @maria

maria: ugh, any example requests or stack traces?

samira: support-bot posted customer repro: they call the TS client -> sometimes Authorization header missing, server returns 401, client retries twice before fail; billing shows token usage for each retry. here's the curl they used:```bash\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/completions \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"hi"}'\n``` (note: no auth header in their snippet, but they say it worked previous week)

aj: they say it worked last week and only started after we published new client packages. which languages?

samira: python + ts, both upgraded to 1.4.0 yesterday (regenerated).

maria: quick guess: OpenAPI change made api_key header param optional in spec -> generator created optional param + different runtime branch that doesn't automatically read REDWOOD_API_KEY from env. so legacy callers relying on implicit env-based behavior end up not sending header.

dave: CI logs show the regen job completed but the template version stayed at v2. We have a mismatch: spec bumped a "required: false" for header, but we didn't bump the generator to v3 which enforces env injection. CI shows:```
ci-bot: regenerate-client --lang=ts --spec=specs/openapi.json --template=v2
Exit code: 0 (changed files)
```

maria: that explains why shape changed without a template update. optional param -> caller code doesn't break at compile but now must pass apiKey explicitly. legacy samples didn't.

samira: customer provided a minimal repro that demonstrates ephemeral failures:```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client(); // before, this read process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY
await client.completions.create({model: 'rwd-1', input: 'hello'});
```
now it throws 401 at runtime.

aj: any quick mitigation? patch we can roll?

maria: short term: publish patch to all SDKs that restores env fallback (non-breaking). I'll open a PR to the generator templates to default to env fallback when header param is optional.

dave: also add CI guard: if spec changes a header param required -> fail regen until template version is bumped and changelog entry exists. Right now we missed a changelog notice.

support-bot: added label "escalation-billing" and linked ticket 45781. Customer wants ETA for fix.

maria: ETA: patch PR in ~2h, publish hotfix packages within 4h. will also create a migration note for customers.

samira: customer confirmed this reproduces in their environment; asked for temporary workaround — tell them to set REDWOOD_API_KEY env or pass apiKey explicitly.

aj: thanks. after hotfix we should run across all generated SDKs and detect any header param optionality changes in the last week. create a small audit script?

dave: I'll add a quick script in the regen pipeline to diff previous spec -> new spec for header params and surface required->optional or optional->required changes. small PR incoming.

maria: one more note: because retries were enabled client-side the missing header caused 401->retry->billing. we'll recommend reducing retry attempts for auth failures in client until fix lands.

samira: escalated to customer with workaround and ETA. adding :rotating_light: on the ticket.

aj: good work team. postmortem item: link regen template version to changelog and CI gating. :thumbsup:
